lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na4Tb4Cu4Cl24 (reduced formula NaTbCuCl6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Tb each in octahedral environments of six Cl neighbors, while Na adopts a close-packed-like arrangement of 12 Cl neighbors. The Cu and Tb octahedra share corners, and face-sharing occurs between Na-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and the octahedral Cu and Tb polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
